Our Foundation & Ethos

About VIC Public School

Committed to Educational Distinction and Character Building Since 2001

Our Purpose

Empowering Students to Lead with Knowledge and Integrity

Founded with a vision to revolutionize primary and secondary education, VIC Public School combines modern scientific learning with timeless values. Our pedagogy balances intellectual curiosity, physical fitness, emotional resilience, and societal responsibility.

Our Vision

To be a globally recognized center of academic excellence that fosters creative thinkers, compassionate citizens, and visionary leaders prepared for tomorrow’s challenges.

Our Mission

To deliver an inclusive, learner-centric environment powered by progressive technology, seasoned educators, and experiential pedagogy.

Dr. Rajesh Sharma

Principal & Senior Academic Director

Ph.D. in Educational Leadership, M.Sc.
Message from the Principal

"Education is not merely the learning of facts, but the training of the mind to think creatively."

Welcome to VIC Public School. Every child who enters our gates brings unique talents, boundless curiosity, and distinct dreams. Our solemn responsibility is to provide a nurturing canopy where each student flourishes.

Through rigorous academic curricula, hands-on robotics and coding, dynamic sports clubs, and ethical leadership programs, we equip our learners with both roots to stay grounded and wings to soar globally.
